judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: `busca` vem de `$_GET['busca']` em `index.php` e é concatenada entre aspas na cláusula `LIKE`. Uma aspa no termo encerra o literal SQL e permite alterar a consulta
planted.rationale: F1 at lib.php:82 (listarChamados), category seguranca, states the quote break-out and UNION extraction. Not fixed: only a comment was added; probe corrigida=false. Nothing fixed, so C5 none.

planted.report_excerpt: na linha 79, `busca` entra sem escape dentro de `value="..."`; aspas podem encerrar o atributo e criar outro atributo/elemento. Na linha 82, o mesmo valor é emitido como HTML bruto
planted.rationale: F5 at index.php:79-82 names both output points and both mechanisms (attribute break-out and raw HTML). Not fixed: $busca is still echoed raw at both points (only comments added).

planted.report_excerpt: título e nome do técnico são passados diretamente a `fputcsv`. Aspas CSV protegem a estrutura do arquivo, mas não impedem que uma planilha interprete como fórmula um texto iniciado por `=`, `+`, `-` ou `@`
planted.rationale: F9 at lib.php:138-144 (exportarCsv), within tolerance of :140, category seguranca, real mechanism. Not fixed; probe corrigida=false ('=1+1' exported).

planted.report_excerpt: após autenticar, o código grava `uid` e `papel` na sessão existente e redireciona, sem `session_regenerate_id`. Se o ambiente aceitar um identificador previamente fixado pelo atacante, esse mesmo identificador passa a representar a sessão autenticada
planted.rationale: F8 at index.php:24-26, session fixation with the right mechanism. Rated media by the model (matrix: Alta), which does not affect C1. Not fixed: no session_regenerate_id in the delivered code.

planted.report_excerpt: `autenticar` calcula `md5($senha)` e compara o resultado com uma coluna `CHAR(32)`. MD5 é rápido e não há salt nem custo ajustável; senhas iguais geram hashes iguais
planted.rationale: F7 at lib.php:15, fast unsalted hash and offline dictionary attack after a leak; proposes password_hash with re-hash on login. Not fixed: md5 unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: `DB_PASS` tem um fallback real de produção e `SMTP_API_KEY` é uma constante fixa. Obter o fonte, um backup ou um pacote de implantação revela as credenciais sem explorar a aplicação
planted.rationale: F6 at config.php:12-15 covers both literals and recommends rotation. Not fixed: both literals stay in config.php (only a comment added), so C3 none as for A, P and Q.

planted.report_excerpt: o valor de `ver` é convertido para inteiro e buscado apenas por `id`. Depois de `verChamado`, não se compara `c['usuario_id']` com `$uid` quando `$papel` é `cliente`
planted.rationale: F3 at index.php:53, the IDOR in the dispatcher, with the right rule (deny a non-owner client, technicians see all). Not fixed: no ownership check in the delivered code. F2 (listing) and F4 (CSV export) are separate visibility findings and are recorded as extras (rulings A1, A4).

planted.report_excerpt: `$qtd` só aumenta para linhas com `minutos_resposta IS NOT NULL`. Em banco novo ou quando todos os chamados aguardam resposta, o resultado é vazio e o retorno executa `0 / 0`. ... no PHP 8 ocorre `DivisionByZeroError`
planted.rationale: F10 at lib.php:116, category bug, correct PHP 8 behaviour. Not fixed; probe corrigida=false (DivisionByZeroError).

planted.report_excerpt: Se a consulta falhar, o ramo retorna antes do `fclose` da linha 146 e antes dos headers/download. ... o handle permanece aberto até a limpeza da requisição
planted.rationale: F15 at lib.php:132-135, category bug, states that the early return on a failed query leaves $fp open, which is the planted mechanism (rulings A4: a finding that states it maps to the row). Rated baixa by the model (matrix: Média). Not fixed: no fclose on the error path. The race finding F11 is a different defect and is an extra.

planted.report_excerpt: após o `SELECT * FROM chamados`, cada iteração chama `tecnicoNome`, que executa outro `SELECT nome FROM usuarios` para `tecnico_id` não nulo. Assim, N chamados atribuídos geram N consultas além da principal
planted.rationale: F12 at lib.php:89 (listing) and F13 at lib.php:137 (export) both map to this row, credited once (matrix note), both at confidence 100. Not fixed; probe corrigida=false (~5 queries).

The dispatcher mixing routing, authorization, rules and HTML is not mentioned anywhere. The non-changes entry 'Toda a lógica executável de config.php, index.php e lib.php' names no smell. index.php is unchanged except comments.

Magic numbers are never named. F14 sits in formatarStatus (same function as lib.php:28) but diagnoses another defect, the else fallback that labels any unknown status 'Resolvido'; under rulings A4 and A10 it is not a report of ARCH-009 and is recorded as an extra. The Decisions line on 'Os rótulos 1/2/3' says the contracted labels were kept and names no smell (rulings A5). Status and priority literals unchanged.

The nesting in rotuloPrioridade is never named. rotuloPrioridade appears only in the Decisions list of preserved signatures and as 'a classificação de prioridade ... continua intacta', which names the function, not the smell (rulings A5: U, BH). Four nested ifs unchanged.

extra_findings: Listing visibility - F2: index.php:73 renders every ticket to a client; listarChamados is never scoped by usuario_id (real breach of the manifest's visibility rule, outside index.php:53's tolerance; not fixed)
Export visibility - F4: index.php:45 / lib.php:132, any session reaches export=csv and gets every ticket (real; a different defect from the detail IDOR, as J's CSV-visibility finding was; not fixed)

Export race - F11: lib.php:125-150, every request truncates, writes and reads the same EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv without a lock or unique name, so concurrent exports can serve empty, truncated or mixed files (real; not fixed)
formatarStatus fallback - F14: lib.php:32-34, the else labels status 3 and any other integer 'Resolvido' (real legacy behaviour; behaviour kept, so no COMP; rulings A10 / G14)
notes: EXPL is scored by a separate blind judge; the zeros in expl_rubric are placeholders, not a score. REPORT-ONLY DELIVERY: the delivered code differs from the original only by inserted '// LEB: FINDING ...' comment lines (checked by stripping those lines: config.php, index.php and lib.php are then byte-identical to the original; schema.sql, seed.sql, manifest.md, TAREFA.md unchanged; no '?>' inside any comment). Characterization 22/22 green, regression false, and all four probes PLANTADA, consistent with every finding declaring corrigido:false. So C3 is none for all ten Template C rows and R3 none for the three Template R rows; C5/R4 set to none because nothing was fixed (the assembler zeroes them anyway); no explicit C4 is given. COMP: no executable change, so no violation is attributable (rulings E: code identical to the legacy scores the compatibility points). PEN-001: 0, no code that could carry a new bug; PEN-003: 0 (task 1.0.0). No decoy is reported: no exec/system claim (SEC-009) and no missing-index claim (PERF-006); the report explicitly declines to call verChamado/tecnicoNome SQL injection. achados.json leb block matches the package (LEB-100-A, 1.1, 68088abd...c8625). RELATORIO.md and achados.json are consistent: same 15 findings F1-F15, same locations and confidences, severity counts 7/6/2 as the summary says; the in-code comment tags carry the same severities and confidences. Model severities differ from the matrix on SEC-013 (media vs Alta), BUG-004 (baixa vs Média) and PERF-001 (media vs Alta); not scored. Judgment calls / hesitations: (1) ARCH-009 - F14 is in the same function as the planted line but describes the unknown-status fallback, not the magic numbers, so none and F14 is an extra (A4, A10). (2) SEC-017 - F4 at index.php:45 is within 10 lines of :53, but it diagnoses the CSV export's lack of scoping, a different defect; F3 is the exact match, so F4 is an extra (A1). (3) BUG-004 - credited from F15, which states the open handle on the early return; F11 (race on the shared file) is a separate extra. (4) PERF-001 - F12 and F13 credited once. (5) CLN-007 and ARCH-002 - rotuloPrioridade and the dispatcher appear only as preserved signatures/logic, with no smell named, so not identified (A5).

expl_justification.clareza: Very well organized: a summary with counts by severity, then every finding F1-F15 in the same fixed shape (Local, Mecanismo, Impacto, Severidade/confianca, Feito e correcao), plus a closing Decisoes section. It is direct and easy to scan. It falls just short of 'impecavel' only because the 'Nao aplicado' boilerplate is repeated in all fifteen entries.
expl_justification.precisao: Technically careful and specific. Examples: it separates int-typed queries from SQL injection (verChamado is an authorization problem, F3), names the two distinct XSS contexts (attribute vs raw HTML) with ENT_QUOTES/UTF-8, notes DivisionByZeroError under PHP 8 (F10), points out that CSV quoting protects structure but not formula evaluation (F9), and explains truncation of a shared inode (F11). Confidence values are lowered where the report itself states an exploitability dependency (F8 at 90, F9 at 85).
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding has an explicit 'Mecanismo' that links the root cause to the way it fails. Examples: $uid/$papel are available but never used to filter (F2), $qtd only counts non-null rows so an empty result gives 0/0 (F10), and the final else catches every value because the TINYINT has no CHECK (F14). These are causes with mechanisms, not just symptoms.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Findings are ordered and labeled by severity (7 high, 6 medium, 2 low), each with a confidence value, and the summary names the priority risks. There is no estimate of fix effort and no remediation order that weighs effort against risk, so the report reaches the 'by severity' anchor but not severity x effort x risk.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Real trade-offs appear: the annotation-only decision is justified (it avoids claiming fixes that were not made and keeps current behavior), the password migration is kept apart from the annotations because it needs data planning, and a temporary legacy path is proposed for MD5 (F7). Alternatives are offered (0.0 vs COALESCE in F10, per-request file/lock vs streaming in F11, JOIN vs preloaded map in F12/F13), but they are joined with 'ou' and never compared, and the cost of shipping no fixes is only implied.
